title: eufy SoloCam Outdoor Security Camera 2-Pack — 3K, No Subscription, 360°
short_description: 2 wireless outdoor cameras with 3K video, colour night vision, spotlight and siren. Usable without a subscription according to the manufacturer, with push alerts to your phone — for house, garden and driveway.
long_description: The eufy SoloCam set (model T8170) contains two wireless outdoor security cameras. They record in 3K resolution and, according to the manufacturer, offer 360° monitoring and 8x digital zoom. In the dark, colour night vision and a built-in LED spotlight provide clear images, and a siren can deter intruders. The cameras connect via Wi-Fi and send push notifications to iOS and Android devices. They are compatible with a solar panel and the eufy HomeBase 3 and, according to the manufacturer, can be used without a subscription. Ideal for house, garden, driveway or shed.
buying_angle: Practical for homeowners who want to keep an eye on house and garden without ongoing subscription costs.
